site.tagline: Movie recommendations and discovery platform. If you can't decide what to watch, you're in the right place.
site.homeTitle: CINEGLOB {'|'} Movie Recommendations and Discovery Platform
site.homeDescription: Can't decide what to watch? Describe the movie or series you feel like in your own words and CINEGLOB finds recommendations for you. Curated collections and upcoming releases are here too.

hero.title: If you can't decide what to watch, you're in the right place.
hero.lead: Write what you feel like in your own words: “a light short-episode series” or “a thriller with a twist ending”. We find it and tell you why we picked it.

search.label: What do you want to watch?
search.placeholder: What do you want to watch? e.g. a fast-paced movie that ends in one evening
examples: A light, funny series with short episodes
A thriller with a twist ending
A warm family movie for the weekend
A crime series you can't stop watching
